description: Uri Tuchman's videos document his process of designing and building whimsical, often absurd mechanical objects and hand tools from scratch, typically combining woodworking, metalworking, and engraving. He tackles projects like custom clocks, hand-built musical instruments, lathes, and automata, frequently embracing mistakes and improvisation rather than polished, error-free results. The appeal lies in watching an artist-craftsman get his hands dirty, troubleshoot problems in real time, and turn silly or eccentric ideas into functional, beautifully made objects.
